sections.text:
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, for Mitsubishi frame 2 steam 
turbine, generator, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by 
Y1in the title block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Eman El Henawey, tested by eng. Wageh 
Khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of Nubaria PS and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
sector

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses)

Check the existence of oil and any other foreign matters remaining inside 
 generator

Check each coil for any distortion, insulation, deterioration, damage or 
 soiling

Check ventilation duets for any deformation, spacers that have slipped out, 
 binding ropes loosened, wedges seasoned or loosened and connection parts 
 discolored by overheating

Check the stator core for any discoloration or damage by overheating clamping 
 bolts, loosened and ventilation ducts soiled

sections.text:
Insulation resistance of rotor coil is measured 
 with 500 V megger and the minimum acceptable value of more than 10 mega ohms for 
 operation

Check to see if balance weights and locking 
 stoppers are loosened

Check to see if journal parts of shaft are worn 
 or damaged

Leakage test for the center bore is conducted 
 with nitrogen gas at radial lead and the pressure drop is considered suitable 
 for operation

After leakage test, the center bore should be 
 bowled with nitrogen gas at 0.5 -1 bar gage sufficiently and closed keenly 
 with plug on remaining the pressure at 0.5 bar gauge
